title: If It Rains
label: ch:ka-if-it-rains
canDo: I can say what will happen if something happens with the -are form (bandare, iddare), add ondu vēḷe for if by chance, and say if not with -adiddare.

payoff.summary: Complete the last lesson of chapter 317: say what will happen if, if by chance and if not, with -are and -adiddare.
